subject: Pricing model clarification + preferred vendor exceptions request
messages:
From: Emily Wong <ewong@nimbushealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Vendor Intake <vendor-intake@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify per-token discount matrix + preferred vendor form

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team at Nimbus liked the latency profile and the cost transparency in your Console. Procurement has a couple of follow-ups before we can move the PO process forward:

1) Your price sheet lists per-token usage discounts tied to commit tiers (e.g., 0-1B tokens / 1B-5B tokens). Can you share a single-page matrix that maps committed monthly spend to effective per-token rates (including example usage buckets)? Our finance team needs this to model our 2027 budget.

2) Procurement requires a completed "Preferred Vendor" form (attached). We also need to confirm whether Redwood accepts POs with monthly invoicing and whether you can accept our standard vendor terms (we will send redlines if any).

3) Quick question on overage: if monthly usage exceeds the committed tier, does Redwood bill per-token at the next tier rate or at list with a reconciliation at month-end?

Please find the vendor intake form attached. Can you come back with the matrix and confirm PO/invoicing flow by EOD Friday?

Thanks,
Emily Wong
Director, Procurement — Nimbus Health

Attachments: nimbus_preferred_vendor_form.pdf (form, 120KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Emily Wong <ewong@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify per-token discount matrix + preferred vendor form

Hi Emily — great to hear the demo was helpful. Answering your points below and attaching a worked example: 

1) Attached is a concise matrix (proposed_flat_rate_pilot.xlsx) showing committed monthly spend bands mapped to effective per-token costs for typical text-gen workloads (we included 1M, 10M, 100M monthly token examples). For hosted API usage-based discounts we compute the effective rate across the month; see the Example tab for math.

2) We can accept a PO with monthly invoicing. Redwood typically invoices at month-end against actual usage, with any shortfall/overage reconciled to the committed amount. For customers that want invoice-first commitments, we also support pre-pay commits with a monthly drawdown. Regarding the Preferred Vendor form, thanks — I filled sections A/B (see attached copy) and marked the exceptions question for legal review.

3) Overage behavior: if you exceed the committed tier mid-month we continue billing at the committed per-token rate up to the committed amount, then additional tokens are billed at the overage rate for that tier. At month-end we reconcile to the band you landed in; if you materially exceeded your committed spend we offer a pro forma adjustment or can honor a one-time grace depending on the contract.

Quick ask: can Nimbus share an expected monthly token range for the first 3 months (best-effort)? That helps us recommend the right commit band.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments: nimbus_preferred_vendor_form_filled.pdf (completed parts A/B), proposed_flat_rate_pilot.xlsx (pricing matrix)

From: Nikhil Sinha <n.sinha@nimbushealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Wong <ewong@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify per-token discount matrix + preferred vendor form

Priyom — appreciate the quick response and the spreadsheet. A couple of follow-ups from Finance/Legal: 

- Nimbus prefers a flat committed spend model (fixed monthly dollar commitment) for the pilot rather than a per-token reconciliation. The reason: our internal chargeback system needs predictable monthly cost lines. Per-token reconciliations create variability we can't easily absorb.

- The vendor form contains a clause (section 6) that asks Redwood to accept our data retention addendum. Can you confirm if Redwood can sign that or provide a counter?

- On PO terms: we'll need Redwood to accept net-30 payment on monthly invoices and a standard indemnity carveout. If Redwood requires invoice-after reconciliation (i.e., variable invoice amounts), we may need an exception for platform teams to pre-approve.

Can Laura or Karthik advise whether Redwood can offer a month-to-month fixed dollar pilot (e.g., $25k/mo for 3 months) that covers up to X tokens and then moves to a usage model after the pilot?

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Wong <ewong@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Clarify per-token discount matrix + preferred vendor form

Laura / Karthik — looping you in. Nimbus is pushing back on the per-token reconciliation and asking for a fixed monthly pilot ($25k/mo x 3) that gives them predictability. They also want us to sign a customer-specific data retention addendum and accept net-30 monthly invoices.

Suggested options:
- Option A (low risk): Offer a 3-month fixed-dollar pilot (pre-pay or monthly invoice with cap) at $25k/mo that covers up to 200M tokens/month; any excess billed at pre-agreed overage rate. Legal would sign a limited data retention addendum that references Redwood's standard privacy policy and excludes infra-level access clauses.
- Option B (standard): Keep usage-based commit tiers and offer a billing/cost modeling session to map expected spend to an appropriate commit band — no custom addendum.

From a commercial perspective, Option A could accelerate the PO but sets an expectation for flat pricing in renewal. Thoughts? I can propose the pilot and draft commercial language for an exec approval.

—Priyom

On Thu, 29 Apr 2027 at 09:20 AM, Nikhil Sinha <n.sinha@nimbushealth.com> wrote:
> Priyom — appreciate the quick response and the spreadsheet...

(Attachment: proposed_flat_rate_pilot.xlsx)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Wong <ewong@nimbushealth.com>, Legal Ops <legal_ops@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Clarify per-token discount matrix + preferred vendor form

Thanks for the context, Priyom. I'm supportive of a limited, time-boxed pilot to unblock procurement — but with guardrails: 

1) Pilot length: 90 days max.
2) Pilot cap: $25k/mo pre-pay preferred; if Nimbus requests monthly invoicing, add a $5k surety (or a signed cap acknowledgement) to mitigate billing variability.
3) Tokens covered: cap at 200M tokens/month; we include a 10% buffer for short bursts.
4) Data retention addendum: Legal Ops to review and provide a one-page amendment that references our standard retention policy and limits to service telemetry. We cannot accept customer language that requires infra-side access or changes core retention architecture.

Karthik — please prepare a one-page commercial memo (numbers + renewal positioning) so we can run the pilot approval with Sales VP. Priyom — if you can get Nimbus to confirm token ranges and accept the pre-pay or surety approach, we'll draft the pilot SOW and sign the filled vendor form with the limited addendum.

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

Attachments: internal_pilot_memo_draft.docx (internal)

From: Emily Wong <ewong@nimbushealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sinha <n.sinha@nimbushealth.com>, Vendor Intake <vendor-intake@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 02 May 2027 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify per-token discount matrix + preferred vendor form

Priyom / Laura — thanks for the quick turn. Nimbus can live with a 90-day capped pilot. We prefer monthly invoicing (net-30) rather than full pre-pay; if you require a surety we can provide a PO with a $5k deposit. We confirm the target is ~120M tokens/month for the pilot (first 30 days lower ramp).

Please send the pilot SOW and the redlined vendor form. We'll execute quickly once Legal confirms the one-page addendum. I opened a DocuSign envelope to speed signing (link below).

Agreed next steps:
- Redwood to send SOW draft & one-page retention addendum by EOD Tue.
- Nimbus to return signed PO with $5k deposit within 48 hours of SOW.

Thanks — Emily
